Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a combination of Affinity Purification (AP-MS) and Protein Correlation Profiling (PCP-MS) using glycerol gradient sedimentation. While the study discusses the ubiquitin-proteasome system, the proteomics assay itself is an AP-MS of the proteasome complex, not a diGly/ubiquitin-remnant enrichment.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consisted of proteasome complexes isolated via antibody-based affinity purification (MCP21 antibody) from various cell lines. While glycerol gradient sedimentation was also used for a subset of analysis, the primary scope for the large-scale correlation study was affinity-purified complexes.
